_comment: Optional per-module CI overrides. Default bazel command is 'test //... --test_output=errors' on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest. Exit 4 falls back to build //.... Commands mirror each source repo's existing gate (fvkit ci.yml: bazel test //... on Linux+macOS plus connection.proto schema check; fastverk-app ci.yml: bazel test //... and Swift renderer builds on macOS only). Directory keys match on-disk prefixes.
